subject: general
question: Bihar state has what percentage of poor population of the country as per Economic Survey of India 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Between 16% and 25%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per the Economic Survey of India 2023-24, Bihar has between 16% and 25% of the country's poor population.
 
• Bihar is one of the states with the highest poverty rates in India, according to recent surveys and reports.
 
• The state has been implementing various poverty alleviation programs, but significant challenges remain.
 
• Poverty in Bihar is attributed to several factors including limited industrialization, high population density, and low agricultural productivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic Survey of India:**

 
 
• An annual document released by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
 
• It provides a detailed report on the state of the economy in the past year and outlines the economic outlook and policy directions for the coming year.
 
• The Economic Survey is presented in the Parliament ahead of the Union Budget.
 
 
 
• **Poverty in India:**
 
 
• India has made significant strides in poverty reduction, but a considerable portion of the population still lives below the poverty line.
 
• Poverty is measured using various indicators, including income levels, access to basic services, and living conditions.
 
• The government has launched several schemes like MGNREGA, PMAY, and NFSA to combat poverty.
 
 
 
• **Factors Affecting Poverty:**
 
 
• High population growth, unemployment, and underemployment are major factors contributing to poverty.
 
• Other factors include lack of access to education, healthcare, and social security.
 
• Rural poverty is often exacerbated by inadequate infrastructure and limited access to markets.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Alleviation Programs:**
 
 
• Various government programs aim to reduce poverty, such as the Public Distribution System (PDS), Mid-Day Meal Scheme, and National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM).
 
• These programs focus on improving income levels, providing employment opportunities, and ensuring food security.
 
• The effectiveness of these programs is regularly reviewed and updated to meet the changing needs of the population.
